say:0:1220101001:0.source_cn: 你、你们有没有听到，听到什么声音？

say:1:1220101002:0.text: It seemed like... a girl singing?

say:2:1220101003:0.text: It's coming from the south of the village. Let's go see what's happening.
say:2:1220101003:0.source_cn: 是村庄南方那边传来的，顺着声音去看看吧。
say:2:1220101003:0.male: It's coming from the south of the village. Let's go see what's happening.
say:2:1220101003:0.female: It's coming from the south of the village. Let's go see what's happening.

say:0:1220102001:0.text: The mellow singing voice in the wind becomes clearer as you advance forward.
say:0:1220102001:0.source_cn: 随着不断前进，风中温柔动听的歌声越来越清晰明亮。

say:3:1220102002:1.text: It's getting clearer. That's definitely someone singing!
say:3:1220102002:1.source_cn: 越来越清晰了，真的有人在唱歌！

say:4:1220102003:1.text: A-are you sure? It must be... just the sea breeze, r-right?
say:4:1220102003:1.source_cn: 那、那是歌声吗？应该只、只只只、只是海风的声音吧？

say:5:1220102004:1.text: Chippy, why is your voice trembling?
say:5:1220102004:1.source_cn: 满满，你的声音怎么在发抖啊……

say:7:1220102006:1.text: There's no one left here. How could a girl be singing in a place like this? It's... it's haunted!
say:7:1220102006:1.source_cn: 这里看起来已经没有人了，怎么会有女孩子在这里唱歌啊……
say:7:1220102006:1.male: There's no one left here. How could a girl be singing in a place like this? It's... it's haunted!
say:7:1220102006:1.female: There's no one left here. How could a girl be singing in a place like this? It's... it's haunted!

choice_prompt:8:1220102006.text: There's no one left here. How could a girl be singing in a place like this? It's... it's haunted!
choice_prompt:8:1220102006.source_cn: 这里看起来已经没有人了，怎么会有女孩子在这里唱歌啊……
choice_prompt:8:1220102006.male: There's no one left here. How could a girl be singing in a place like this? It's... it's haunted!
choice_prompt:8:1220102006.female: There's no one left here. How could a girl be singing in a place like this? It's... it's haunted!

say:9:1220102007:1.text: Oh? If it's an enemy, Chippy's sword is ready for anything!
say:9:1220102007:1.source_cn: 嗯？是敌人吗？那样满满就不怕了！满满的剑无所畏惧！
say:9:1220102007:1.male: Oh? If it's an enemy, Chippy's sword is ready for anything!
say:9:1220102007:1.female: Oh? If it's an enemy, Chippy's sword is ready for anything!

say:10:1220102009:1.text: You changed your tune so quickly, Chippy...

say:11:1220102010:1.text: But who could it be, singing such a hauntingly beautiful tune in this desolate village?
say:11:1220102010:1.source_cn: 不过，到底会是谁呢？在这无人的村落里，唱着这样美妙又有...
say:11:1220102010:1.male: But who could it be, singing such a hauntingly beautiful tune in this desolate village?
say:11:1220102010:1.female: But who could it be, singing such a hauntingly beautiful tune in this desolate village?

say:12:1220102011:1.source_cn: 主人，我们去看看到底是怎么回事吧！

say:14:1220102008:1.text: Right, maybe there's a survivor we missed before! Magister, you're so smart!
say:14:1220102008:1.source_cn: 对哦，说不定有幸存者躲起来了，只是我们之前没找到！
say:14:1220102008:1.male: Right, maybe there's a survivor we missed before! Magister, you're so smart!
say:14:1220102008:1.female: Right, maybe there's a survivor we missed before! Magister, you're so smart!

say:0:1220103001:0.text: The singing seems to be coming from this house.
say:0:1220103001:0.source_cn: 歌声好像是从这间屋子传出来的！

say:3:1220104001:0.text: Excuse me, are you travelers? Is it safe outside now?
say:3:1220104001:0.source_cn: 请问，是外来的旅人吗？现在外面安全了吗？

say:5:1220104002:0.text: Oh, it really is a girl's voice!
say:5:1220104002:0.source_cn: 咦，真的是女孩子的声音……！

say:6:1220104003:0.source_cn: 太好了，这座村里还有生还者！

say:8:1220104004:0.text: We're mages that happened to pass by. Are you alright?
say:8:1220104004:0.source_cn: 我们是路过的魔法师，你还好吗？
say:8:1220104004:0.male: We're mages that happened to pass by. Are you alright?
say:8:1220104004:0.female: We're mages that happened to pass by. Are you alright?

say:9:1220104005:0.text: Mages? Then, can you please help me?
say:9:1220104005:0.source_cn: 魔法师？那、那你们可以帮帮忙吗？
say:9:1220104005:0.male: Mages? Then, can you please help me?
say:9:1220104005:0.female: Mages? Then, can you please help me?

say:10:1220104006:0.text: When the Graveborn pirates came, everyone fled or hid.
say:10:1220104006:0.source_cn: 之前，那些亡灵海盗来劫掠的时候，大家四处找地方避难，逃...

say:11:1220104007:0.text: Jonah told me to hide in this house and went to save the others. He's been gone for so long! Did you happen to see him?
say:11:1220104007:0.source_cn: 乔纳森让我在这间屋子里躲好，转头又说要去救其他村民——...

choice_prompt:12:1220104007.text: Jonah told me to hide in this house and went to save the others. He's been gone for so long! Did you happen to see him?
choice_prompt:12:1220104007.source_cn: 乔纳森让我在这间屋子里躲好，转头又说要去救其他村民——他已经离开很久了！你们有在外面看到他吗？

say:13:1220104009:0.text: My name is <style="highlight">Cecilia</style>. Jonah is... a friend.

say:14:1220104010:0.text: He told me to hide and lock the door, but now I can't open it, no matter what!
say:14:1220104010:0.source_cn: 他让我躲好、把门锁上离开之后，再也没有回来。这扇房门，...

say:15:1220104011:0.text: How is that possible? Could the door be jammed?
say:15:1220104011:0.source_cn: 怎么会？是门被堵住了吗？

choice_prompt:16:1220104011.text: How is that possible? Could the door be jammed?
choice_prompt:16:1220104011.source_cn: 怎么会？是门被堵住了吗？

say:17:1220104012:0.text: This lock is incredibly intricate! If it's forced, it locks automatically. Without the specific key, it's almost impossible to open!
say:17:1220104012:0.source_cn: 这是很精密的机关锁……！如果被暴力冲击就会有自动锁死，...
say:17:1220104012:0.male: This lock is incredibly intricate! If it's forced, it locks automatically. Without the specific key, it's almost impossible to open!
say:17:1220104012:0.female: This lock is incredibly intricate! If it's forced, it locks automatically. Without the specific key, it's almost impossible to open!

say:19:1220104013:0.text: Jonah designed it. He's the finest craftsman I know! He promised to guard the key with his life.
say:19:1220104013:0.source_cn: 是乔纳森设计的，他是我见过最棒的工匠！他说，他会用生命...

say:20:1220104014:0.text: The Graveborns tried to break in, but I didn't make any noise.
say:20:1220104014:0.source_cn: 那些亡灵海盗来的时候也试图破门而入，但我躲着没出声。

say:21:1220104015:0.text: The banging, the screams, and the chilling laughter... I've never heard such dark, cold laughter. My soul felt frozen.
say:21:1220104015:0.source_cn: 外面不断传来惨叫和砸门的声音，还有可怕的尖笑……我从来...

say:22:1220104016:0.text: And then, silence. I couldn't hear any birds, or footsteps. There was just a deathly stillness...
say:22:1220104016:0.source_cn: 然后，一切都安静了。没有鸟鸣，没有脚步，死一样的寂静……

say:23:1220104017:0.text: Magister, can you try using magic to open the door?
say:23:1220104017:0.source_cn: 主人，能用魔法试试看把门打开吗？
say:23:1220104017:0.male: Magister, can you try using magic to open the door?
say:23:1220104017:0.female: Magister, can you try using magic to open the door?

say:24:1220104018:0.text: It's locked tight and purely mechanical. Magic might not work...
say:24:1220104018:0.source_cn: 已经锁死了，是纯粹的机关，用魔法可能不太行……

say:26:1220104019:0.text: It's alright, take your time. I'm perfectly safe in this house.
say:26:1220104019:0.source_cn: 没关系，我在这间屋子里很安全。

say:27:1220104020:0.text: Can you help me find Jonah? He can unlock this door. I'm excited to see him again!
say:27:1220104020:0.source_cn: 帮我找找乔纳森，好吗？我希望他平安无事！
say:27:1220104020:0.male: Can you help me find Jonah? He can unlock this door. I'm excited to see him again!
say:27:1220104020:0.female: Can you help me find Jonah? He can unlock this door. I'm excited to see him again!

choice_prompt:30:1220104020.text: Can you help me find Jonah? He can unlock this door. I'm excited to see him again!
choice_prompt:30:1220104020.source_cn: 帮我找找乔纳森，好吗？我希望他平安无事！
choice_prompt:30:1220104020.male: Can you help me find Jonah? He can unlock this door. I'm excited to see him again!
choice_prompt:30:1220104020.female: Can you help me find Jonah? He can unlock this door. I'm excited to see him again!

say:31:1220104024:0.text: Jonah's house is <style="highlight">south of the village</style>, down the slope, right by the path.

say:32:1220104025:0.text: If there is a spare key, he might have kept it at home... Please find him for me. I beg you.
say:32:1220104025:0.source_cn: 如果有备用钥匙，他也可能放在家里……帮我找到他，好吗？...

say:33:1220104026:0.text: A-alright, we'll look for him. We promise!
say:33:1220104026:0.source_cn: 好……好的，我们会去看看！你放心！

say:38:1220104028:0.text: Though we agreed, the chances of Jonah being alive are slim...
say:38:1220104028:0.source_cn: 虽然答应她了，但乔纳森生还的可能，实在是……

choice_prompt:39:1220104028.text: Though we agreed, the chances of Jonah being alive are slim...
choice_prompt:39:1220104028.source_cn: 虽然答应她了，但乔纳森生还的可能，实在是……

say:40:1220104029:0.text: Let's go check Jonah's house. If we find the spare key, we can free Cecilia.
say:40:1220104029:0.source_cn: 我们还是先去乔纳森家看看吧，要是能找到备用钥匙也好，就...

say:41:1220104030:0.text: We can't let her stay locked up forever, after all!
say:41:1220104030:0.source_cn: 总不能让她一直被关着！

say:42:1220104031:0.text: Well, let's go find his house.
say:42:1220104031:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们去乔纳森家看看吧。

choice:30:1:2.text: Do you know where he could be?
choice:30:1:2.male: Do you know where he could be?
choice:30:1:2.female: Do you know where he could be?

say:44:1220104021:0.text: What is it? Why do you sound so serious all of a sudden?
say:44:1220104021:0.source_cn: 怎么了？难道乔纳森出事了？
say:44:1220104021:0.male: What is it? Why do you sound so serious all of a sudden?
say:44:1220104021:0.female: What is it? Why do you sound so serious all of a sudden?

say:46:1220104023:0.text: ... I'm sure Jonah is fine! I have faith in him!
say:46:1220104023:0.source_cn: ……乔纳森不会有事的！我相信他！

choice:30:2:3.text: Alright, we'll go try to find him.
choice:30:2:3.male: Alright, we'll go try to find him.
choice:30:2:3.female: Alright, we'll go try to find him.

choice:12:0:1.text: The Dead Tide Fleet was here?!
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 亡灵？你是说死潮舰队来过这里？
choice:12:0:1.male: The Dead Tide Fleet was here?!
choice:12:0:1.female: The Dead Tide Fleet was here?!

say:47:1220104008:0.text: Dead Tide Fleet? I don't know... Those Graveborns swarmed up from the sea cliffs under cover of darkness, like a gray tide crashing ashore...
say:47:1220104008:0.source_cn: 舰队？我不知道……那些亡灵是趁夜色从海岸悬崖下翻上来的...

say:0:1220106001:0.text: Look, gold coins! It seems the Dead Tide Fleet wasn't interested in money.
say:0:1220106001:0.source_cn: 是金币！死潮舰队看来并不在意钱财。

say:1:1220106002:0.text: No key here. Let's search somewhere else!
say:1:1220106002:0.source_cn: 没有钥匙，去看看别处吧！

say:0:1220107001:0.text: *Cough cough* There's so much dust. Still no key!
say:0:1220107001:0.source_cn: 咳咳，都是粉尘。没有钥匙！

say:0:1220108001:0.text: This is just moldy, gray food... Gross!
say:0:1220108001:0.source_cn: 是积攒的食物。呃唔，都变成霉灰了……

say:2:1220110001:0.text: It's a journal, it has Cecilia's name in it!
say:2:1220110001:0.source_cn: 这是本日记！上面写着塞西莉亚的名字呢！

say:3:1220110002:0.text: It seems like Jonah's the owner of this journal. It mentions changing the lock at Cecilia's house.
say:3:1220110002:0.source_cn: 可能是乔纳森写的，日记的主人说给塞西莉亚家换了机关锁。

say:4:1220110003:0.text: From this entry, it seems Jonah had deep feelings for her.
say:4:1220110003:0.source_cn: 从日记上能读得出来，乔纳森……好像很喜欢塞西莉亚。

choice_prompt:5:1220110003.text: From this entry, it seems Jonah had deep feelings for her.
choice_prompt:5:1220110003.source_cn: 从日记上能读得出来，乔纳森……好像很喜欢塞西莉亚。

say:6:1220110004:0.text: There's no clue about the key's location. We'll need to ask Cecilia for more information.
say:6:1220110004:0.source_cn: 日记里没说钥匙的位置，恐怕还得问塞西莉亚有没有别的线索了。
say:6:1220110004:0.male: There's no clue about the key's location. We'll need to ask Cecilia for more information.
say:6:1220110004:0.female: There's no clue about the key's location. We'll need to ask Cecilia for more information.

say:7:1220110005:0.text: But, with the house in this state, could Jonah be...
say:7:1220110005:0.source_cn: ……但是，房屋已经这样了，乔纳森他难道……

say:8:1220110006:0.text: Let's go back and talk to Cecilia first and let her know what we found.
say:8:1220110006:0.source_cn: 至少，先回去告诉塞西莉亚吧……也算给她一个交代。

choice:5:0:1.text: Did it mention the spare key?
choice:5:0:1.male: Did it mention the spare key?
choice:5:0:1.female: Did it mention the spare key?

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 但是，好像只有日记的一部分

say:2:1220111001:0.text: Sorry, Cecilia. Jonah's house was... a mess. We didn't find the key or see him at all.
say:2:1220111001:0.source_cn: 抱歉，塞西莉亚，乔纳森家附近……呃，有点乱，我们没找到...

say:3:1220111002:0.text: Is that so? Well, that's not surprising. Jonah was never one for tidiness.
say:3:1220111002:0.source_cn: 是吗，那家伙就是不喜欢收拾房间。

say:4:1220111003:0.text: I used to clean for him, and then he'd complain he couldn't find anything afterward.
say:4:1220111003:0.source_cn: 之前我给他整理，他还会抱怨“让你一收拾就找不到了”。

say:5:1220111004:0.text: Though we didn't find the spare key, we did find a journal!
say:5:1220111004:0.source_cn: 虽然没有找到钥匙，不过我们找到了一本日记！

say:6:1220111005:0.text: Jonah's journal? What does it say?
say:6:1220111005:0.source_cn: 日记？是乔纳森的日记吗？他写了什么？

say:10:1220111008:0.text: Would you like to hear it? We can read it to you.
say:10:1220111008:0.source_cn: 塞西莉亚，你想听听看吗？我们可以读给你听。

say:11:1220111009:0.text: ... Yes, please. I want to know.

choice_prompt:12:1220111009.text: ... Yes, please. I want to know.

say:13:1220111010:1.text: "I yearn for the boundless fields and whispering forests she serenades, for the eternal snow that never fades. Her songs paint a world of such breathtaking beauty."
say:13:1220111010:1.source_cn: “我向往她歌声里所唱的一望无际的田野和森林，向往永远不...

say:14:1220111011:1.text: "Yet, I'm bound. I understand what chains me, what holds me from wandering away."
say:14:1220111011:1.source_cn: “但是我被绊住了。我知道是什么让我离不开。”

say:16:1220111012:0.text: Jonah's always dreamed of leaving Greenbrook for adventures elsewhere...
say:16:1220111012:0.source_cn: 乔纳森，他一直想离开绿水村，去其他地方冒险……

say:17:1220111013:0.text: I remember walking with him on the beach south of his house. He talked about the mechanical drawbridge in Rustport and the stone mills they have in the empire, with his eyes full of wonder.
say:17:1220111013:0.source_cn: 我还记得，我们一起在他家南面的海滩上漫步。他提到锈锚港...

say:18:1220111014:0.text: I once sang that song to him—the one you heard, "Beyond the Horizon".
say:18:1220111014:0.source_cn: 我曾经在那里给他唱过歌……就是被你们听见的那首，《向远...

say:20:1220111015:0.text: We didn't see anyone on our way here. Could he have gone south?
say:20:1220111015:0.source_cn: 我们一路来的路上都没有人，难道乔纳森往南边走了？

say:21:1220111016:0.text: I'm not sure... Can you check near the beach?
say:21:1220111016:0.source_cn: 我不知道……能不能拜托你们去看一眼海滩附近？

say:22:1220111017:0.text: How could he abandon me and go off all alone...?
say:22:1220111017:0.source_cn: 他怎么会抛下我，自己离开呢？怎么会呢……

say:24:1220111018:0.text: Don't worry, Cecilia! We'll definitely find him!

say:0:1220112001:0.text: But if he went south, that means he went close to where the Dead Tide Fleet landed...
say:0:1220112001:0.source_cn: 海滩吗？但那里应该离死潮舰队登陆的地方不远。

say:1:1220112002:0.text: I do hope Jonah is safe...
say:1:1220112002:0.source_cn: 希望乔纳森平安无事啊……

say:0:1220113001:0.text: There's a Graveborn over there! What's that next to him?
say:0:1220113001:0.source_cn: 那边有亡灵！而且，它身边是不是有东西？

say:4:1220117002:1.text: He's not attacking us anymore... But we can't communicate with him.
say:4:1220117002:1.source_cn: 不行，虽然不攻击我们了，但完全没法交流啊……

choice_prompt:5:1220117002.text: He's not attacking us anymore... But we can't communicate with him.
choice_prompt:5:1220117002.source_cn: 不行，虽然不攻击我们了，但完全没法交流啊……

say:6:1220117003:0.source_cn: 乔纳森，你还记得塞西莉亚小姐吗？

say:8:1220117005:0.text: When the Dead Tide Fleet attacked, you told her to hide at home, right? Don't worry, she's safe! They didn't find her.
say:8:1220117005:0.source_cn: 死潮舰队上岸时，你让她躲在家里，对吧？放心吧，她很安全...

say:10:1220117007:0.text: But her supplies must be running low by now. We need to get her out of there.
say:10:1220117007:0.source_cn: 但是，现在物资可能不够了，我们得让塞西莉亚小姐出来。

say:11:1220117008:0.text: So could you tell us where you hid the spare key? We swear we'll keep Cecilia safe.
say:11:1220117008:0.source_cn: 你能把开门钥匙交给我们吗？我们一定会保证她的安全的。

narration:13:1220117010:0.text: The undead body before you rips open his stomach and pulls out a small item.
narration:13:1220117010:0.source_cn: 面前的亡灵生物剖开肚子，取出一把钥匙。

say:15:1220117011:1.text: Is this... the key?! He hid the key inside his stomach?!
say:15:1220117011:1.source_cn: 这是……钥匙？！他把钥匙藏在肚子里了？！

say:16:1220117012:0.text: Did he swallow it to keep it hidden from the Dead Tide Fleet...?
say:16:1220117012:0.source_cn: 是为了防止死潮舰队拿走，所以被转化为亡灵前，把钥匙吞进...

say:24:1220117016:0.text: Don't worry, sir. We'll get Cecilia out right away and bring her here!
say:24:1220117016:0.source_cn: 放心吧，乔纳森先生……我们这就去把塞西莉亚小姐带出来！

say:0:1220118001:0.text: But... how do we tell Cecilia what happened?
say:0:1220118001:0.source_cn: 我们该怎么告诉塞西莉亚呢……

say:0:1220119001:0.text: We're back, and we found the key! We'll get you out now.
say:0:1220119001:0.source_cn: 塞西莉亚，我们找到钥匙了！我们这就放你出来……

say:0:1220121001:0.text: You look around, but there's nothing here except the distant sound of waves.
say:0:1220121001:0.source_cn: 环视四周，只有遥远的海浪声，周围空无一人。

say:4:1220121002:1.text: J-Jonah's gone?! He was just here!
say:4:1220121002:1.source_cn: 乔、乔纳森先生不见了？！他刚刚明明还在这里！

say:5:1220121003:1.text: We said we'd bring Cecilia here... Why did he leave? He wanted to see her, didn't he?
say:5:1220121003:1.source_cn: 我们离开时说过会带塞西莉亚来见他……为什么他离开了？他...

say:6:1220121004:1.text: Perhaps he didn't want Cecilia to see him like that...
say:6:1220121004:1.source_cn: 可能是，不想让塞西莉亚见到他现在的样子吧……

say:8:1220121006:1.text: I'd recognize his warm heart, no matter his appearance.
say:8:1220121006:1.source_cn: 他那颗明亮而温暖的心，不管变成什么样子，我都认得出来。

choice_prompt:9:1220121006.text: I'd recognize his warm heart, no matter his appearance.
choice_prompt:9:1220121006.source_cn: 他那颗明亮而温暖的心，不管变成什么样子，我都认得出来。

say:10:1220121007:1.text: He might be at the ferry on the western beach.
say:10:1220121007:1.source_cn: 我想，可能在西边海滩的渡口吧。
say:10:1220121007:1.male: He might be at the ferry on the western beach.
say:10:1220121007:1.female: He might be at the ferry on the western beach.

say:11:1220121008:1.text: Whenever he got upset, he'd go to the ferry to feel the breeze. I always found him there.
say:11:1220121008:1.source_cn: 他遇到不顺心的事，总会躲在渡口吹风。每次我都会去那里找他。

say:12:1220121009:1.text: Every time, he'd point to the ferry and say that one day, he would save enough money and sail to distant lands.
say:12:1220121009:1.source_cn: 每一次，他都指着渡口说，等将来攒够钱，就从那里启航，前...

choice:9:1:2.text: Do you know how to find him?
choice:9:1:2.male: Do you know how to find him?
choice:9:1:2.female: Do you know how to find him?

say:0:1220122001:0.text: Do you think he really went to the ferry...?
say:0:1220122001:0.source_cn: 乔纳森真的会去渡口吗……

say:1:1220122002:0.text: Trust me... no, trust in Jonah.
say:1:1220122002:0.source_cn: 相信我……不，相信乔纳森吧。

say:0:1220125001:0.text: I can still hear Cecilia singing... What was that song called again?
say:0:1220125001:0.source_cn: 还能听到塞西莉亚的歌声……

say:2:1220109001:0.text: We've scoured every corner and found no sign of a key... or Jonah.
say:2:1220109001:0.source_cn: 找了一圈，完全没找到钥匙的影子……也没有乔纳森。

say:3:1220109002:0.text: There really is no one else left in this village...
say:3:1220109002:0.source_cn: 这座村庄里，果然一个人都没有了。

say:4:1220109003:0.text: After the Dead Tide Fleet's raid, everything has withered away. Even what's left is decaying.
say:4:1220109003:0.source_cn: 死潮舰队来劫掠后，村庄已经什么都不剩了，仅存的东西也都...

say:5:1220109004:0.text: If Cecilia finds out, she'll be heartbroken...
say:5:1220109004:0.source_cn: 要是让塞西莉亚知道，她一定会很失望吧……

choice_prompt:6:1220109004.text: If Cecilia finds out, she'll be heartbroken...
choice_prompt:6:1220109004.source_cn: 要是让塞西莉亚知道，她一定会很失望吧……

say:7:1220109005:0.text: Let's keep looking. We owe Cecilia that much, at least!
say:7:1220109005:0.source_cn: 我们再努力找找吧！不管什么都好，也是给塞西莉亚一个交代……

say:8:1220109006:0.text: Oh, oh! Chippy found something! There's a book in the corner.
say:8:1220109006:0.source_cn: 满满发现了——！角落里好像有一本书！

narration:13:12020118:0.text: Following the direction in which Chippy points, you discover a journal in the corner.
narration:13:12020118:0.source_cn: 顺着满满手指的方向，你们发现了角落里的笔记。

say:2:1220114001:1.text: It's the rest of Jonah's journal!

say:3:1220114002:1.text: This half has already decayed... It must have been here for a long time.
say:3:1220114002:1.source_cn: 这半本日记也已经腐朽了……应该已经过去很久了。

say:4:1220114003:1.text: Cecilia must have been waiting for Jonah for ages.
say:4:1220114003:1.source_cn: 塞西莉亚一定也坚持了很久很久，等着乔纳森回去吧。

choice_prompt:5:1220114003.text: Cecilia must have been waiting for Jonah for ages.
choice_prompt:5:1220114003.source_cn: 塞西莉亚一定也坚持了很久很久，等着乔纳森回去吧。

say:7:1220114004:0.text: Magister, why do you look so down? Are you troubled for them too?
say:7:1220114004:0.source_cn: 主人，你脸色怎么这么难看？你也在为他们俩难过吗？
say:7:1220114004:0.male: Magister, why do you look so down? Are you troubled for them too?
say:7:1220114004:0.female: Magister, why do you look so down? Are you troubled for them too?

say:8:1220114005:1.text: Let's search the area for more clues. If Jonah's diary is here, he might have been too!
say:8:1220114005:1.source_cn: 我们再在附近找找线索吧，既然乔纳森重要的日记在这里，那...

say:9:1220114006:1.text: He wrote in his journal that he was hiding something important. Maybe it was the spare key...
say:9:1220114006:1.source_cn: 日记上说，他把某个重要的东西藏起来了，可能就是能打开塞...

say:10:1220114007:0.text: Ah! Look! The dead guy on the ground there is moving!!
say:10:1220114007:0.source_cn: 咦咦咦？！你们看！地面上那个亡灵生物动起来了！

narration:15:12020123:0.text: The creature near the journal suddenly rises and lunges at you.
narration:15:12020123:0.source_cn: 笔记旁的亡灵突然爬起，冲着你们发动攻击。

say:4:1220120001:0.text: You found it? But where's Jonah? Why didn't he come back with you?
say:4:1220120001:0.source_cn: 你们拿到钥匙了？乔纳森呢？他怎么没和你们一起回来？

say:9:1220120002:0.source_cn: 塞西莉亚？！你、你这个样子是——

choice_prompt:10:1220120002.source_cn: 塞西莉亚？！你、你这个样子是——

say:13:1220120005:0.text: I remember now. When the Graveborns attacked, everyone was fleeing...
say:13:1220120005:0.source_cn: 我想起来了，亡灵海盗来的时候，大家都在奔逃……

say:14:1220120006:0.text: Jonah hid me here and told me to hold on and wait for him.
say:14:1220120006:0.source_cn: 乔纳森把我藏在了这个房间里，让我坚持住，一定要等他回来。

say:16:1220120008:0.text: It's been so long... so long that I forgot I had died.
say:16:1220120008:0.source_cn: 原来已经过了这么久啊……久到我连自己已经死去这件事都忘记了。

say:17:1220120009:0.text: I'm so sorry, Cecilia... I can't get my words out!
say:17:1220120009:0.source_cn: ……很抱歉，塞西莉亚……呜，我说不下去了！

say:18:1220120010:0.source_cn: 塞西莉亚……乔纳森他、他其实……

say:19:1220120011:0.text: He's gone, isn't he? I should have known... If he were alive, he wouldn't have left me here, all alone.
say:19:1220120011:0.source_cn: 他去世了吧。我应该知道的……毕竟，如果他还活着，不会让...

say:20:1220120012:0.text: Even when we fought, we'd always make up within two days... We've never been apart this long.
say:20:1220120012:0.source_cn: 我们就算吵架，没有两天也一定会和好……我们从来没有分开...

say:21:1220120013:0.text: You managed to open the door. That means you found him, right?
say:21:1220120013:0.source_cn: 你们能打开房门，说明已经找到乔纳森了，对不对？

say:22:1220120014:0.text: Please, take me to him. Even with... the way I am now, I need to see him one last time.
say:22:1220120014:0.source_cn: 请带我去见他吧……即便已经成为幽灵，我也想再见他一面。

narration:24:12020132:0.text: Cecilia finally steps out of the room. You notice she has turned into a spirit.
narration:24:12020132:0.source_cn: 塞西莉亚终于走出了房间。直到这时你们才发现，她已经变成...

say:6:1220124002:0.text: Honestly, you made me wait for so long!
say:6:1220124002:0.source_cn: 真是的，居然让我等了这么久！

say:9:1220124005:0.text: Look at us now, both like this. Let's not run away anymore, alright?
say:9:1220124005:0.source_cn: 你瞧，我们现在都已经是这个样子了，就别再逃跑啦？

say:11:1220124007:0.text: ...Well, then. Shall we finally take this chance to begin our journey?
say:11:1220124007:0.source_cn: ……不过，正好。趁现在的机会，我们要不要出发呢？

say:12:1220124008:0.text: You've always dreamt of an adventure, just like in those songs—wandering through golden fields, crossing cascading waterfalls and rainbows, gazing over the deep scars that mark the land.
say:12:1220124008:0.source_cn: 你一直想去远方冒险，就像歌里唱的那样，去看金色的原野，...

say:13:1220124009:0.text: You've waited for so long. The door is open now, and nothing can hold you back. I'll be by your side.
say:13:1220124009:0.source_cn: 你已经等了这么久。现在房门的锁已经打开了，再没有东西能...

say:14:1220124010:0.text: We'll share a long, wondrous life together.
say:14:1220124010:0.source_cn: 我们会一起度过非常漫长，非常精彩的人生。

say:16:1220124012:0.text: Thank you all. Jonah and I are ready to embark on our eternal adventure.
say:16:1220124012:0.source_cn: 善良的魔法师。谢谢你们。我和乔纳森要走了。这会是一场永...
say:16:1220124012:0.male: Thank you all. Jonah and I are ready to embark on our eternal adventure.
say:16:1220124012:0.female: Thank you all. Jonah and I are ready to embark on our eternal adventure.

say:17:1220124013:0.text: Come on, Jonah. Let's go together...
say:17:1220124013:0.source_cn: 来吧，乔纳森，我们一起出发吧。

narration:25:12020138:0.text: Cecilia sings the song "Beyond the Horizon" as she and Jonah ride off into the vast sea together.
narration:25:12020138:0.source_cn: 塞西莉亚唱着那首《向远方去》，和乔纳森一起融入了茫茫的大海。

narration:26:12020137:0.text: You and Cecilia arrive at the ferry, where she meets Jonah again.
narration:26:12020137:0.source_cn: 你们和塞西莉亚一起来到了渡口，她终于又见到了乔纳森。

narration:27:12020137:0.text: You and Cecilia arrive at the ferry, where she meets Jonah again.
narration:27:12020137:0.source_cn: 你们和塞西莉亚一起来到了渡口，她终于又见到了乔纳森。
